subject.title: fix: bound miscellaneous unbounded file reads across 5 modules

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` and `openclaw config patch --file` intentionally reject existing input files above 8 MiB as the permanent supported compatibility contract?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded and documented, but this is a new failure mode for existing public CLI workflows rather than a purely internal refactor.

options.title: Accept the 8 MiB contract
options.body: Keep the shared 8 MiB ceiling and its new documentation/tests as an intentional protection against unbounded allocation.

options.title: Preserve larger-file compatibility
options.body: Choose a different bounded-input strategy or a higher established limit before merge if current automation may legitimately use files above 8 MiB.

recommendation.title: Accept the 8 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared 8 MiB ceiling and its new documentation/tests as an intentional protection against unbounded allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer authored the branch's consolidation and ownership refactor, so they have the strongest evidence-backed context for accepting the CLI compatibility boundary.
